description.value: Chocho Hot Pot is a Chinese hot pot restaurant on the Kingsway corridor in Burnaby, offering both vegan and vegetarian menu options alongside traditional hot pot dining. The restaurant is smoke-free, air-conditioned, and accepts cash and major cards. It sits on a well-travelled urban cycling route through Burnaby.
